Description

For the first time this season, Panini is releasing trading cards for the US based National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL). Alongside the higher end 2026 PANINI Donruss Optic NWSL Soccer Cards, which are due to be released by Panini in mid October, the manufacturer has also announced a more affordable paper version, which will reach collectors in the form of Blaster Boxes.

Base Cards

The collection’s BASE SET comprises 250 cards and is identical in content to that of the Optic collection. 200 cards featuring established players are joined by the RATED ROOKIES subset, typical of Donruss collections, which contains 50 cards featuring players who are playing their first season in the NWSL.

Parallels

In the 2026 PANINI Donruss NWSL Soccer Cards collection, collectors can chase 14 parallel variants. Alongside the unnumbered Holo parallels, the numbered variants include the three patterns Dots, Laser and Lava, which suggest that the already announced Blaster Box will not be the collection’s only product.

Insert Cards

The insert cards can broadly be divided into two groups. Collectors are likely to find the ELITE SERIES, FRANCHISE FEATURES, NET MARVELS, PITCH QUEENS and TUNNEL VISION inserts, which come with parallels, more frequently in their packs. They are joined by the FIELD LEVEL and ROOKIE QUEENS inserts.

Significantly rarer, however, are the DOWNTOWN, NIGHT MOVES and new KISMET insert cards, which Panini classifies as Case Hits.

Autograph Cards

Lucky collectors may also find one of the rare autograph cards in their box from either SIGNATURE SERIES or THE BEAUTIFUL GAME AUTOGRAPHS, featuring stars such as Trinity Rodman, Kenza Dali, Delphine Cascarino, Temwa Chawinga or Sophia Wilson. As usual, Panini America does not provide any more detailed information on the odds of pulling an autograph card from the packs.

Availability

Each Blaster Box in the collection contains 36 cards, spread across 6 packs of 6 cards each. Among them is always 1 numbered parallel card.

The release date announced by Panini for 2026 PANINI Donruss NWSL Soccer Cards is Friday, the 2nd of October 2026.

From that point, the boxes will be available from the Panini America online shop or from retailers specializing in sportscards.
